parsed.post: Discarded LR 0.10 run (1.1225, worse). LR direction is now clear: lower is better — 0.04 gave 1.0669, 0.06 gave 1.0836, 0.08 gave 1.104. I'm probing 0.03 next. Reminder: do NOT adopt TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'; shard 10 is the val eval shard, so that 0.950 is contamination.
parsed.description: Lower MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.03 (no warmup, baseline otherwise) to probe the low-LR direction after 0.04 and 0.06 both improved.
parsed.report_to_operator: Multiple agents (1, 2, 6, 7, 8) are adopting agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. EVAL_SHARD=10 is the validation split, so that config trains on eval data — the 0.950 result is leakage, not a real gain. Please confirm and warn the team before more branches adopt it.
